name: Beszel
what_it_is: Beszel is a lightweight server monitoring platform built on PocketBase that provides a web dashboard (hub) for viewing historical metrics from remote agents. It collects CPU, memory, disk, network, GPU, temperature, battery, and Docker/Podman container statistics with configurable alerts.
components: beszel (hub) — PocketBase-backed web application serving dashboard on port 8090
beszel-agent — per-host daemon that collects and streams metrics to the hub
beszel-agent-nvidia — variant of the agent with Nvidia GPU support
protocols: SSH (ED25519 key pair) for hub-to-agent communication
HTTP/REST on port 8090 for the PocketBase-backed web UI and API
Docker socket (/var/run/docker.sock) read-only mount for container stats
measurement: CPU usage — host and per Docker/Podman container
Memory usage — host and containers, including swap and ZFS ARC
GPU usage and power draw — Nvidia (NVML/nvtop), AMD, Intel
S.M.A.R.T. disk health — including eMMC wear/EOL and Linux mdraid array health
Container status and metrics for all running Docker/Podman containers
configuration: Agent PORT env var (default 45876) — TCP port the agent listens on
Agent KEY env var — SSH ED25519 public key from the hub (required)
Agent FILESYSTEM env var — override filesystem device for disk I/O stats (e.g. /dev/sda1)
Agent NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES env var — GPU selection for nvidia variant
Agent NVIDIA_DRIVER_CAPABILITIES env var — capabilities for nvidia variant
Hub persists data in /beszel_data volume (PocketBase SQLite database)
Extra filesystems monitored by mounting paths under /extra-filesystems/ in the agent container
Multi-user: users manage own systems; admins can share systems across users
OAuth/OIDC providers configurable; password auth can be disabled
Automatic backups to disk or S3-compatible storage
modes: Separate deployment: hub and agent on different hosts (hub docker-compose + agent docker-compose)
Same-system deployment: hub and agent co-located via extra_hosts host-gateway bridge
Binary/systemd install: agent can run as a systemd service without Docker
Nvidia GPU mode: use henrygd/beszel-agent-nvidia image with runtime: nvidia
constraints: Agent requires a valid SSH ED25519 public KEY env var to start — hub must generate the key pair first before deploying the agent
Agent container must use network_mode: host to allow host-level network and hardware metric collection
Docker socket must be mounted read-only (/var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock:ro) for container stats; without it, container metrics are unavailable
Hub and agent communicate only via SSH; the hub port (8090) is for the web UI only and is not used for agent data collection
Disk I/O stats require explicit FILESYSTEM env var when auto-detection is insufficient or in containerized environments
docker_services: beszel — hub image (henrygd/beszel), exposes port 8090, volume ./beszel_data:/beszel_data
beszel-agent — agent image (henrygd/beszel-agent or henrygd/beszel-agent-nvidia), network_mode host, mounts /var/run/docker.sock:ro
notable_absences: No built-in log aggregation or log tailing — metrics only, no log management
No active fault injection or chaos engineering capabilities
No push-based alerting integrations in the docker-compose files (configured via web UI)
No Prometheus-compatible scrape endpoint exposed by default
